summary: Worker metric temporal_worker_task_slots_used never drops to 0 even when completely idle, preventing KEDA autoscaling to zero replicas. The metric oscillates between 0 and 1 even hours after all workflows complete.
userImpact: Users cannot achieve auto-scaling to zero replicas in Kubernetes because worker metrics never indicate full idle state.
keyQuote: we have no workflows running, and the worker is completely idle, however the worker is still emitting the metric `temporal_worker_task_slots_used` which is oscillating between 0 and 1
